items.title: Compliance Drives Revenue. Here's What to Count
items.covered: How security and compliance programs can demonstrate commercial value, including customer trust and sales support.
takeaways: Track trust-center engagement and security questionnaires as evidence of customer demand.
Connect compliance work to sales enablement and renewal support rather than counting completed controls alone.

items.title: AI Agents Will Use Every Permission You Give Them
items.covered: The security implications of giving AI agents permissions to access systems and perform actions.
takeaways: Limit agent permissions to the tasks they need to perform.
Test access boundaries and agent behavior as part of security control validation.
